scope: Pinned locally vendored official K1 locomotion policy and existing named MuJoCo adapter; no claim about latest upstream or omitted hardware controllers.
assumptions: H0 is read-only except the two new audit outputs. H1 is a future isolated MuJoCo experiment, not authorized hardware control.
Active gains are K1WalkTaskCfg overrides, not base K1_CFG or prepare_state gains.
Indices are zero-based; source lines are one-based; angles are radians.

independent_static_checks.native_FK_scope: Separate MjData, active walk default, original XML, mj_forward only; arm body-origin change proves direction, not full collision-envelope extent or dynamic stability.

observation.history_update: roll(-1) then replace newest frame; oldest-to-newest flatten
observation.reset: last_action zero; history None; filtered target copied from default

action.head_targets: held at default zero through zero action scale
action.formula: q_raw = q_default + 0.25 * scatter(action, policy_to_robot), with right_elbow_pitch action reduced by 0.2; q_filtered[k] = 0.2*q_filtered[k-1] + 0.8*q_raw[k]
action.last_action_semantics: clipped actor output BEFORE arm correction, scaling, and target filtering

existing_upper_body_interface.conclusion: No dedicated upper-body arbitration interface in the verified local subset. Generic 22-joint target boundary exists, but adding a mask is a new experiment.

allowed_interfaces.name: official_body_velocity_command
allowed_interfaces.details: Existing set_velocity((vx,vy,yaw)) preserves official policy ownership of all eight arms.

allowed_interfaces.name: read_only_state_target_history_telemetry
allowed_interfaces.details: Read original action, history, filtered target, named joint state, raw/clipped/delivered torques; do not mutate policy internals.

allowed_interfaces.name: external_copy_of_22_joint_targets_before_PD
allowed_interfaces.details: New H-only wrapper calls compute_targets once per 20ms; clones tensor; modifies only selected named arm slots 2..9; passes a full tensor through existing apply_control/finish_physics_step. Never mutate original returned tensor or policy.filtered_dof_target; head and leg target slots must remain identical to that step original.

allowed_interfaces.name: separate_MjData_forward_kinematics_preview
allowed_interfaces.details: A separate preview data object may set candidate qpos and call mj_forward for geometry only. It does not prove dynamic stability or interception.

forbidden_shortcuts: Mutating original A-G code, tests, official source/model/XML, gains, limits, gravity, collision geometry or physics timestep.
Writing simulation qpos/qvel during controlled execution to enforce a pose; fixed base, mocap/weld support, or external forces to appear stable.
Writing data.ctrl directly then invoking scene.step: official apply_control overwrites it.
Setting scene.targets once before a policy tick: scene.step replaces it at every policy tick.
Using set_reference_qpos ghost rendering as proof that physical joints moved.
Treating arms as unobserved or removing them from policy/history or changing actor input/output shapes.

override_risks.finding: All eight arm joints occur in actor output and q/dq/history; action override is a coupled full-body policy intervention. Leg commands can change on future steps even if leg target slots are untouched now.

Post-filter target replacement leaves last_action as nominal actor output, not executed arm command. Keep this official nominal-action convention in the minimal H1, log both nominal and applied targets and action discrepancy; no unvalidated claim that history describes executed action.
override_risks.alternative: Writing reconstructed executed last_action changes actor inputs and is a separate ablation; (target-default)/0.25 ignores EMA memory and right-elbow correction and is not the original last_action.

override_risks.finding: External arm residual bypasses the official EMA and its internal filtered_dof_target retains nominal values. Removing residual abruptly can create a target discontinuity; rate-limit engage/release residual without writing filter state.
Policy arm slots are [0,1,4,5,8,9,12,13], not a contiguous first-eight block. PD uses robot order indices2..9. Name mapping and explicit immutable complement are required.

Clip_action=100 allows nominal +/-25rad offsets before filtering; neither target-range nor target-slew clamps exist in the policy. XML joint constraints and +/-14Nm arms torque clips do not guarantee safe trajectories.
Scene applies official PD every1ms; direct torque write is overwritten. Composed targets must be the inputs actually delivered to apply_control every substep.

Arm mass/inertia, self-contact and ball impulses couple into free-base balance. Shoulder-pitch root geometries are visual only; enabled arm collision primitives are shoulder-roll cylinders and elbow meshes, not a continuous arm envelope.

Official falling check stops controller when projected_gravity.z>-0.5 but continues computing this inference. Named adapter blocks using its result after stop; neither official stop flag nor apply_control alone is a hard motor zeroing path. H wrapper must terminate before further physics/control after stop.

H1_minimal_proposal.purpose: Verify whether one small arm residual actually changes delivered targets, torque and physical joint motion while the unchanged locomotion actor remains stable; no goalkeeper/save-success claim.
H1_minimal_proposal.environment: Separate H-only script/module and output directory, free-base unchanged scene, no ball contact, zero velocity command, 1ms physics and20ms original policy. Existing 297 tests remain unchanged.
H1_minimal_proposal.nominal_history_choice: Preserve original last_action, observations and history update; record intervention mismatch instead of editing actor input.
steps: H1a zero residual path: original baseline and H wrapper on independent same initial MjData; bitwise compare per-substep time/qpos/qvel/ctrl and per-policy targets/last_action/history/filter. Any mismatch blocks nonzero tests.

H1b initial amplitude0.05rad,2s quintic ramp up and2s quintic ramp down,2s hold and recovery; separate matched zero baseline. Begin selected left/right roll feasibility with left positive/right negative, as native active-default FK confirms these lift and widen arms. Keep zero velocity/free base/no ball contact. Do not mutate obs/last_action/filter/PD.

H1c only after initial gate succeeds, separately consider0.15rad single-left roll/single-right roll/bilateral roll/bilateral shoulder pitch, then0.30rad only after every required0.15rad case succeeds. Higher-amplitude durations are to be fixed before execution; recompute slew bound from chosen ramp. No trial executed by this H0 audit.

Every selected joint must show direction-consistent median response at least50% of residual amplitude versus corresponding time-matched zero baseline during last1s hold. Insufficient response blocks upgrade. First unstable case stops larger-amplitude tests.
No further amplitude increase, locomotion/contact combination or goalkeeper-success claim in this feasibility experiment.
success_checks: Zero residual gives exact baseline parity.
Applied target equals nominal target except selected arm slots at every physics step.
Leg/head target slots unchanged at each step relative to that same step nominal inference; future leg physical behavior may differ.
Nonzero residual reaches actual PD input and torque; actual joint q differs reproducibly from matched baseline, not merely a wrapper getter.
No fall, nonfinite value, BAD warning, unexpected time reset, new forbidden contact, limit margin violation or torque stop; returns to nominal target with bounded residual ramp.
Report achieved angle, settle/error, tilt/z, drift, torque saturation and recovery without claiming proven safe full-body arbitration.
H1_minimal_proposal.decision: Conditional go for isolated0.05rad post-filter residual feasibility gate;0.15/0.30rad only after previous gates. No official upper-body support or independent-balance guarantee.
H1_minimal_proposal.schedule: Initial gate: quintic s(u)=10u^3-15u^4+6u^5,2s up,2s hold,2s down; peak slope=1.875*amplitude/ramp_duration =0.046875rad/s for0.05rad. Higher-stage schedule fixed before run, never inherited silently.
H1_minimal_proposal.roll_sign_note: Verified native FK using active default: left positive/right negative raises and widens elbow_yaw-link origins. At+left0.15/-right0.15, left y grows0.197320809 to0.220264297 and z grows1.016448087 to1.025843853 (right mirrors y). These body-origin observations do not establish full collision-envelope extent. Earlier unverified sign inference was corrected before execution.
H1_minimal_proposal.response_score: For every selected joint separately: median(sign(residual)*[q_H(t)-q_zero(t)]) over final1s hold divided by abs(residual amplitude). Time-aligned matched baseline required; do not accept instantaneous peak alone.

H1_stop_conditions.name: source_or_test_drift
H1_stop_conditions.criterion: Any change to pinned official hashes or protected original A-G sources/tests; zero-residual parity failure.

H1_stop_conditions.name: identity_mask_shape
H1_stop_conditions.criterion: Missing/duplicate names, wrong mapping/transmission, target shape not22, actor output not20, history not10x69, or any unselected target changed.

H1_stop_conditions.name: numerical
H1_stop_conditions.criterion: Any nonfinite state/target/action/torque/time, new BADQPOS/BADQVEL/BADQACC/BADCTRL warning, or unexpected time reset.

H1_stop_conditions.name: policy_stop
H1_stop_conditions.criterion: Official projected_gravity.z>-0.5 or controller.is_running false; do not invoke any subsequent PD/physics step.

H1_stop_conditions.name: physical_fall
H1_stop_conditions.criterion: Free-base z<0.3m or trunk upright z<0.5 (tilt>60degrees), from actual quaternion every physics step.

H1_stop_conditions.name: early_stability_guard
H1_stop_conditions.criterion: After settling, trunk tilt>15degrees, free-base z<0.42m, or any new self-contact stops the current case and all larger-amplitude upgrades. These are experiment guards, not certified robot limits. Track baseline drift/height/tilt as context.

H1_stop_conditions.name: range_or_slew
H1_stop_conditions.criterion: Applied selected-arm target outside XML range inset0.05rad, actual q outside XML range, abs residual>current authorized stage amplitude(initial0.05rad;0.15/0.30rad only after gate), or derivative exceeds schedule-derived limit(initial0.046875rad/s for2s quintic). Check nominal+residual every substep, not only task default.

H1_stop_conditions.name: torque_saturation
H1_stop_conditions.criterion: Any arm raw PD demand reaches/exceeds14Nm continuously for>0.10s, or delivered torque/control exceeds official active limit plus1e-5Nm. Do not raise gains/limits to finish the experiment.

H1_stop_conditions.name: unexpected_contact
H1_stop_conditions.criterion: New self-contact/non-foot-ground contact after settling or any ball/goal contact in no-contact H1. First new self-contact stops case and larger amplitude upgrades; preserve pair IDs and delivered-step evidence.

H1_stop_conditions.name: insufficient_delivered_response
H1_stop_conditions.criterion: Any selected joint direction-consistent median response over final1s hold below50% of stage amplitude versus time-matched zero baseline blocks larger amplitude. This is limited feasibility, not a safe/effective-motion pass.

protected_originals.test_count_note: 297 is parent-provided protected baseline count; no additional test run or claim in this audit.
